description: Source file implementing common functionality for BufferD3D classes in ANGLE project, handling static and dynamic buffer management, static buffer caching, and index range computation.

classes.name: BufferD3D
classes.description: Implements common buffer functionality for Direct3D in ANGLE, managing static/dynamic buffers, cache, and index range calculations.

methods.name: updateSerial
methods.description: Updates the serial number for the buffer instance.

methods.name: updateD3DBufferUsage
methods.description: Sets buffer usage type based on gl::BufferUsage and initializes static data if needed.

methods.name: initializeStaticData
methods.description: Creates static vertex and index buffers if they do not exist.

methods.name: getStaticVertexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a static vertex buffer matching specific attribute and binding.

methods.name: invalidateStaticData
methods.description: Clears static buffer cache and resets static buffers, reinitializing if static usage is set.

methods.name: promoteStaticUsage
methods.description: Promotes buffer to static usage if enough unmodified data has accumulated.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Computes the index range for a draw call based on buffer data.
